name: Financial Advisor
description: Structure documentation for a financial advisor affiliated with an independent broker-dealer network.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the financial advisor record.

fields.name: crdNumber
fields.description: FINRA Central Registration Depository (CRD) number uniquely identifying the advisor.

fields.name: firmCrdNumber
fields.description: CRD number of the registered broker-dealer the advisor is affiliated with.

fields.name: firmName
fields.description: Name of the registered broker-dealer or RIA the advisor operates under.

fields.name: licenses
fields.description: List of FINRA Series licenses held by the advisor (e.g., Series 7, Series 65).

fields.name: designations
fields.description: Professional designations held (e.g., CFP, CFA, ChFC).

fields.name: officeAddress
fields.description: Primary office address with street, city, state, postalCode, and country fields.

fields.name: assetsUnderManagement
fields.description: Total assets under management or advisement in USD.

fields.name: registeredSince
fields.description: Date the advisor first registered with FINRA.
